svg.title: Native argon hollow-core broadening and compression — OpticalSetup setup
svg.desc: Open the existing argon hollow-core fiber setup with physical coupling, a diagnostic split, negative-GDD compensation and autocorrelation readouts before and after compression. The hollow-core model is an approximate nonlinear broadening and chirp model. It does not establish ionization, damage margins, spatial beam quality or a physically measured compressed pulse.
